第19章地崩山摧壮士死
少顷，钱晨便跟着黄玉函来到一个偏僻的小院，里面只有洪四海和空明神僧两人，顽石道长还在五湖厅主持大局，只听空明神僧道：“堂主身系武林大局，岂可如此不小心……十二元辰若不是设计废了堂主一臂，岂敢如此猖狂？”
洪四海爽朗笑道：“岂能让这些小人毁了我义兄的遗骸。”
看到黄玉函进来，便招呼他：“玉函啊！为我义兄布置灵堂收拾的如何了？”
黄玉函低头回答：“具已办妥。”
“我要用十二元辰的人头，祭奠二哥在天之灵！”洪四海强一直忍着的怒气，这一刻才终于显露了出来。
黄玉函请钱晨为洪四海查看伤处，钱晨打开洪四海包扎好的右拳，看到那皮开肉绽的伤口，便是一皱眉，他沉思了许久，才抬起头来。看到神情微微有些紧张的空明神僧，钱晨淡定一笑，从怀里取出药匣，配置好伤药给洪四海换上。
并道：“洪老英雄手上伤势颇重，只怕要几个月才能好利索了。我在伤口用了一些狼虎之药，虽然延缓了伤势痊愈的时间，却加快了短时间内的恢复效果。今夜过后，老英雄便能动拳了……只是动用一次，伤势便恶化一分，若是短时间内来上几次，只怕……”
空明禅师紧张问：“只怕什么？”
“只怕这只手要废！”
空明神僧的好脾气，也被钱晨弄得恼怒了！“岂能如此……”
“如此正好……”洪四海摆手道：“让我亲手为义兄和堂内死难的弟子报仇！”
洪四海和空明神僧还要商量些什么，黄玉函就和钱晨先行告退了。路上钱晨笑道：“我对这些江湖事，实在所知不多，许多英雄我都叫不上名字，也难以搭话。”
黄玉函道：“这有何难，我为小兄弟引荐一番。”
黄玉函先指着一位年轻剑客介绍道。
“这位是正道后起之秀，三绝剑客康千灯，一手剑法凌厉无比，虽然在宗师之中还只是新人，凭着家传神兵惊鸿剑，却早已不在任何一位成名已久的宗师高手之下。”
“这位是江湖上盛名玉女夜叉中的玉女，沈婉君沈女侠……”黄玉函指着一位面容俏丽，却一脸寒霜，身着素服的美貌少妇，颇为遗憾的跟钱晨解释道：“五年前，夜叉王富大侠，为十二元辰所害。沈女侠矢志复仇，改名号为玉罗刹。如今杀夫仇人就在眼前，却一时难以手刃，只怕最是煎熬……”
“富大侠虽然面貌丑陋，却有侠义心肠。而沈女侠曾是江湖上有名的大美人。两人结为夫妻，到是叫江湖上的朋友吓了一大跳呢！不过这对侠侣十分恩爱，羡煞旁人。只可惜……”
“这位是一线天赵逞赵大侠，赵大侠执掌长风镖局，贵为总镖头，一杆残阳枪曾挑太平山十八处寨子，叫那‘八百里不平山，归乡人魂断径’，从此改名为太平山！”
总镖头赵逞是一个沉默的汉子，常常独自一人擦拭那柄神枪残阳。

“还有杜紫淮，杜大侠，碧血丹心剑法神妙莫测。”
钱晨顺着看过去，却是一位中年文士打扮的落魄剑客，几缕长发随意的散落在额前，眼中无神，有一种酒醉的迷茫感。
“那位不起眼的老者，便是将相叟李老英雄。他名号气派，实则有来历，他家传一杆神兵春秋笔，却偏偏生性喜爱枪法，后来容纳笔法枪法为一炉，自开一家，号称将相，已是江湖中最有可能突破大宗师的一位顶尖高手。”
这位李老英雄却是一个极其精神的干瘦老者，腰间挂着一只铁笔。
“那位方正君子，便是徐晓阳徐大侠。徐家正气山庄威名赫赫，虽然以暗器传家，却从不暗中出手伤人，家传神兵五色石，也是江湖最有名，威力最大的神兵之一。”

Chapter 19 The Earth Collapses and the Mountains Destroy the Heroes to Death
After a while, Qian Chen followed Huang Yuhan to a remote courtyard, where there were only two people, Hong Sihai and Kongming Divine Monk. Taoist Master Nashi was still presiding over the overall situation in Wuhu Hall. He only heard Kongming Divine Monk saying: "The hall master is involved in the overall situation of the martial arts, how can he be so careless... If Twelve Yuanchen hadn't designed to destroy the hall master's arm, how could he dare to be so rampant?"
Hong Sihai smiled heartily and said: "How can we let these villains destroy the remains of my sworn brother?"
Seeing Huang Yuhan come in, he greeted him: "Yuhan! How are you decorating the funeral hall for my sworn brother?"
Huang Yuhan lowered his head and replied: "The tools are ready."
"I want to use the head of Twelve Yuan Chen to pay tribute to my second brother's soul in heaven!" The anger that Hong Sihai had been holding back finally came out at this moment.
Huang Yuhan asked Qian Chen to check Hong Sihai's injury. Qian Chen opened Hong Sihai's bandaged right fist and frowned when he saw the raw wound. He thought for a long time before raising his head. Seeing the slightly nervous Kongming Divine Monk, Qian Chen smiled calmly, took out the medicine box from his arms, prepared the medicine for Hong Sihai, and put it on Hong Sihai.
He also said: "The old hero Hong's hand is seriously injured. I'm afraid it will take a few months to recover. I used some wolf and tiger medicine on the wound. Although it delayed the healing time of the injury, it accelerated the recovery effect in a short period of time. After tonight, the old hero will be able to use his fists... Just using it once will make the injury worse. If it happens several times in a short period of time, I'm afraid..."
Zen Master Kongming asked nervously: "What are you afraid of?"
"I'm afraid this hand will become useless!"
Qian Chen was also annoyed by the good temper of Kongming Divine Monk! "How can this be so..."
"It's just right..." Hong Sihai waved his hand and said, "Let me personally avenge my sworn brother and the disciples who died in the hall!"
Hong Sihai and Monk Kongming had something to discuss, so Huang Yuhan and Qian Chen resigned first. On the way, Qian Chen smiled and said, "I really don't know much about these Jianghu affairs. There are many heroes that I can't even name, and it's hard for me to talk to them."
Huang Yu wrote: "What's the problem? I'll introduce you to my little brother."
Huang Yuhan first pointed at a young swordsman and introduced him.
"This is a rising star in the righteous path, the Three Ultimate Swordsman Kang Qiandeng. His swordsmanship is extremely fierce. Although he is still a newcomer among the masters, with the family's magic sword Jinghong Sword, he is no longer inferior to any long-established masters."
"This is the most famous Yaksha in the world, Shen Wanjun and Shen Nvxia..." Huang Yuhan pointed to a beautiful young woman with a cold face and plain clothes, and regretfully explained to Qian Chen: "Five years ago, the Yaksha King Fu was killed by Twelve Yuanchen. Shen Nvxia was determined to take revenge and changed her name to Jade Rakshasa. Now the enemy who killed her husband is right in front of her, but it is difficult to kill her for a while. I'm afraid it will be the most painful..."
"Although Fu Daxia has an ugly appearance, he has a chivalrous heart. And Shen Nuxia was once a famous beauty in the world. The two got married, which shocked their friends in the world! However, this chivalrous couple is very affectionate and envies others. It's a pity..."
"This is Daxia Zhao, the leader of the first line of heaven. Zhao Daxia is in charge of the Changfeng Escort Bureau. You are the chief escort. He once picked out the eighteen villages in Taiping Mountain with a setting sun gun, calling it 'Eight hundred miles of uneven mountain, the souls of those who return home will die'. From then on, it was renamed Taiping Mountain!"
The chief escort leader Zhao Cheng is a silent man, who often wipes the setting sun of the magic gun alone.
"There is also Du Zihuai, Du Daxia, and the swordsmanship of Jixue Danxin is incredible."
Qian Chen looked over and saw a down-and-out swordsman dressed as a middle-aged scribe. A few strands of long hair were casually scattered in front of his forehead. His eyes were dull, giving him a feeling of drunken confusion.
"That inconspicuous old man is the old hero Li, the Prime Minister. His name is grand, but actually he has a history. His family has a magic spring and autumn pen, but he loves marksmanship by nature. Later, he incorporated the brush and marksmanship skills into one, and opened his own shop, known as GeneralXiang is already the top master in the world who is most likely to break through to the Grand Master level. "
This old hero Li is a very energetic, skinny old man with a stylus hanging from his waist.
"That upright gentleman is Xu Xiaoyang and Daxia Xu. The Xu family's Zhengqi Villa has a great reputation. Although hidden weapons are passed down to the family, they never hurt anyone secretly. The five-color stone, the family's magic weapon, is also one of the most famous and powerful magic weapons in the world. "
